title: [Expense Agent] Create per diem line when approving travel requests with Per Diem Included
summary: When approving travel requests with Per Diem Included, the system now automatically creates a per diem expense line for each traveler based on matching expense rules, with blocking validation if no appropriate rule is found.
key_points: Per diem lines are automatically created during travel request approval when Per Diem Included is enabled
Category resolution matches rules by location and trip start date, selecting the first active category
Approval fails with a clear error if no matching rule exists or the rule lacks a Daily Rate condition
Per diem lines are exempted from merchant and receipt requirements, consistent with mileage handling
Centralized validation logic in ExpenseRuleValidation.IsMerchantReceiptRequirementApplicable improves maintainability
quote: When a travel request with Per Diem Included is approved, each traveler's newly created expense report now gets a per diem line automatically.
